label: GeForce RTX 5070 · Core Ultra 5 235 · 64 GB RAM · SATA SSD
notes: The PC also has an RTX 2070 (card 1); this environment measures on the RTX 5070 alone (gpu_index 0, launches with --gpu 0). The card runs at its default power limit (250 W); the CPU is held to 65 W (PL1 = PL2, set in the BIOS) after it reached 105 °C at the board's 121 W. 11 models: the ISTA quants on disk, Gyro-M, and Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 up to Q2_K_XL (chosen for a 937 GB disk), then Gyro-S and coder IQ1_M added on 2026-11-08. UD-IQ3_XXS and UD-Q3_K_XL were dropped on 2026-11-07: they streamed weights from the SSD (200–300 MiB/s reads, prefill a quarter of the others).
